verdict.rationale: Puzzle is accounting software, so period locking is a fair axis, but the evidence pack never documents locking closed periods or requiring an explicit reopen. The nearest items are AI Close month-end automation and reversing entries created when manual journal entries are edited. These are adjacent close and audit-trail behaviors, not a period lock.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can lock closed periods so prior-period numbers cannot change without an explicit reopening
